entry_points.text: SMI window enable is no-op with TD guard. Emulation check retries for TD MMIO, INIT/SIPI blocked for TD else while VMXON outside guest. ISR update and PIR sync return neutral for TD else delegate; delivery diverts TD to posted-only helper.

VT state/control wrappers isolate TDs with zeroed segments/tables, zero CPL/size, CRs reported valid and writes ignored, while ordinary guests delegate CPUID, exception bitmap, segment, CPL, CR, EFER, IDT/GDT and DR7.

VT layer steers to confidential or conventional. Confidential sees neutral flags, shadows, masks, windows and entry/exit, skips fine flush, direct inject, hypercall and threshold, reports NMI allowed with module merge; conventional NMI/IRQ withheld while blocked or nested run pending.

exports.text: VMX/TDX helpers offer EPT sync, ISR update, segment/CPL/size queries, CR0/CR4 validation, IDT/GDT/DR7 access and posted-only TDX delivery. Segment honors real mode, CR checks honor nesting and SMM, tables use limit plus base, per-vCPU keeps posted descriptor, real-mode and emulation flags.

Backends implement TLB flush all/current/address/guest, event inject/mask/window/cancel with real-mode emulation where failure triple-faults, plus pgd, flags, shadow, hypercall, entry/exit, CR8 and debug sync. Full prefers EPT else VPID, current skips invalid, confidential broad; NMI/IRQ withheld while blocked or nested pending; mask caches unmasked, windows degrade to IRQ under SW/STI else NMI; prepare unhalts, cancel finalizes; TD pgd shared else EPT/combined; hypercall in-place; entry shows pending event, exit reason/qual/vectoring; CR8 from prio compare.

hazards.text: PIR clear orders against DMA notify even uniprocessor. Processing requested only if top vector from posted to avoid blocked loop; lower bits reevaluated later. Sync with APICv off is host bug.

invariants.text: IO/MSR bitmaps need valid page only when use-bit set. TPR shadow needs valid APIC page and zero threshold nibble without delivery. APIC access needs valid page; APICv needs TPR shadow, forbids x2APIC with access virt, needs exit-on-interrupt and constrained posted config. PML/unrestricted/MBEE need EPT; shadow VMCS needs valid bitmaps; NMI chains exiting, virtual and window.

EPTP allows only advertised UC/WB, walk 4/5, legal GPA, reserved clear and advertised AD. Exit/entry verify against masks; MSR lists need zero or bounded aligned count with legal end. Events constrain type/vector/errcode/len. Host checks CR bits, CR3, CET, canonical pointers, PAT/perf, width-dependent RIP/CR4, selectors, bases and EFER. Only DF/TS/NP/SS/GP/PF/AC carry error code. VMFUNC/switch/timer/CR3-count reflect controls.

Built EPTP uses WB with walk from root level plus dirty tracking, invalid without backing; flush uses context sync if valid else global via INVEPT. Secondary preserves dynamic APIC/shadow bits. Fixed1 starts all-ones/perf baseline plus feature allowances. PT copies leaves with per-cap mask. Nested posted needs guest mode plus matching cached vector else fallback. VPID follows nested if present else primary; empty needs no flush.
Implementation relies on external bit, mask, scoped-guard, memory, barrier and once-warning helpers owned outside this dossier; their internals are not described here.

locks.text: vAPIC mode, ISR update and CR8 hold VMCS01 guard while rewriting. Nested outer state is lock-bound so posted fast paths use cached vector/pending with ordering versus mode checks.

state_machines.text: vAPIC mode skipped for TD or without kernel LAPIC/accel; XAPIC uses access virt with reload, X2APIC uses virt when supported then masks refresh. Bitmap caches x2APIC mode, rebuilds 0x800-0x83f on change, skipped without HW. PIR sync drains notify, merges to IRR, refreshes RVI outside guest with APICv else requests processing only if top vector came from posted.

Posted delivery tries nested first, needs APICv, posts else materializes in LAPIC with kick. After CPUID, XSAVE pruned and user MSRs, secondary, feature/fixed bits, PT, transactional, masks, enclave and exception bitmap refreshed.

structs.text: MSR lists need 16B align, posted descs 64B align with legal GPA; TPR/threshold use 4b nibbles, notify upper byte zero. x2APIC covers 0x800-0x83f, higher intercepted. Status holds RVI low SVI high with -1 as zero. CS carries L bit13 DB bit14. TPR rechecked by HW as guest may rewrite after validation; failed VM-scoped reads benign.
Nested CR4 allowances derive from CPUID 0x1 and 0x7:0/1; PT caps from 0x14 leaves. IF comes from flags enable bit; shadow distinguishes STI vs MOV-SS; hypercall patch uses architected VMCALL opcode.

Arch retention keeps DR0-3/DR6/DR7 with trapping markers, IRQ/NMI descriptors and accounting; virt keeps block hints, activity, VPIDs, exit reason/vectoring and TD pending/qual. DR6 restored to reserved pattern; NMI tracking assumes sustained suppression and TD merge full service; exception high error bits dropped with step hint for BP under suppression.
